{{Quote|We mine for the alum that the Mandalores use to make their armor. Basically, we get to work down in these nasty caves all day long so the Mandalorians can look nice.|Japer Witter|<ref name="SWG:JW">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=conversation|Japer Witter|Endor}}</ref>}}
'''Japer Witter''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Miner/Legends|miner]] who lived on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of]] [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was the foreman of the miners operating in the [[alum]] mines below the [[Death Watch bunker]].<ref name="AED" />
